newsitem.title: KENYA: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar, up on pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar, up on pound.

text.p: NAIROBI, June 30 (Reuter - The Tanzanian shilling fell on the dollar but gained on pound sterling, the Central Bank of Tanzania (BoT) said on Monday.

Bank officials told Reuters by telephone from Dar es Salaam that against the dollar, the shilling exchanged at 624.6900 from to Friday's 624.2445. The shilling appreciated against the pound exchanging at 1039.5176 compared to Friday's 1040.7436.
